newsitem.title: USA: Railamerica to focus on rail operations.
newsitem.headline: Railamerica to focus on rail operations.

text.p: RailAmerica Inc said Monday that it intends to focus its efforts on expanding its core rail business, and will also dispose of its motor carrier operations, including Steel City Carriers Ltd.

The company said it will substantially expand our rail operations through its acquisition program, noting its largest acquisition to date, Ferronor rail line in Chile, should grow significantly over the next several years, especially if trade improves within Latin America and mining interests increase copper production, Ferronor's principal commodity hauled.

The company added that its decision to dispose of its motor carrier operations should have a favorable impact on RailAmerica going forward, allowing it to focus on growing core rail properties through internal growth, as well as through acquisition.
The company estimates that there are more than 25,000 miles of rail line for sale in North America alone, and it expects to acquire its "fair share."
Operating margins of the short line rail business have traditionally been substantially greater than those of the motor carrier industry, said the company.
